nodes.title: LOCK SOURCE AUDIO / GENERATE VIDEO ONLY

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> (source: <Picture 1>): The idol singer — a young woman with waist-length wavy cobalt-blue hair fading to ice-blue tips, white frilled headband with an upright blue ribbon loop and dark fin-shaped ear ornaments, small blue bows at both sides of her head, navy-and-blue idol-maid stage dress with gold embroidery, white lace off-shoulder long sleeves and choker-style bow with a blue jewel, white ruffled corset lacing, layered white petticoat and a glossy blue whale-tail ornament at the back of the skirt, white ankle socks and navy Mary-Jane shoes. She grips a silver handheld microphone in her right hand (mic action per <Picture 2>).
<Subject 2> (source: <Picture 2>): The concert venue and stage — a huge night-time arena stage with black truss towers, scaffolding, dozens of multi-beam spotlights and moving heads, warm glowing work lamps, drifting haze, a curved front edge with monitors, and three large LED walls: the left and right walls display the chibi whale-maid cartoon, the wide centre wall displays a white whale-tail logo above the white visible text "deepseek". In the foreground a dense silhouette crowd raises blue light sticks. The venue is reused as the physical set and lighting scheme; the singer visible in <Picture 2> is replaced by <Subject 1>.
<Subject 3> (source: <Picture 3>): The chibi cartoon avatar — a two-head-tall cartoon girl with long wavy blue hair, white frilled headband, dark wing-like ear fins, navy dress with light-blue panels and white apron carrying a small whale mark, a blue whale tail, tiny navy shoes; used strictly as the animated content playing on the LED walls, where she sings and dances with the rhythm of <Audio 1>.
<Subject 4> (source: <Picture 4>): Only the dragon is transferred — a colossal Eastern dragon with dense grey-black plate scales, antler-like horns, layered dark mane and beard, long thin whiskers coiling forward, glowing amber eyes, heavy clawed forelimbs and a long spike-fringed tail. The human figure, rocky gorge, mountains, waterfall and sunset of <Picture 4> are excluded.
<Subject 5> (source: <Picture 5>): The dragon's on-stage size and placement — the dragon is grounded across stage centre and stage left with its coiled body filling roughly two thirds of the stage width, its rearing neck rising to about the height of the centre LED wall and its head looming over the stage; the singer (<Subject 1>) performs small at stage right beside the mic stand, dwarfed by the dragon, exactly as in the framing of <Picture 5>.
<Subject 6> (source: <Audio 1>): The fast-tempo, high-energy hot song track used as the live performance audio; the singer's lip movements, her dance footwork and the crowd's jumping are all cut to its beat and timing.

summary:
[reference generation] 20-second, 16:9 live-concert sequence. The blue-haired idol from <Picture 1> performs the fast hot song of <Audio 1> on the massive arena stage of <Picture 2>, while the giant dragon from <Picture 4>, sized and placed as in <Picture 5>, dances and head-bobs on stage beside her under chaotic sweeps of stage light; the chibi whale-maid cartoon from <Picture 3> sings and dances on the LED walls; after ten seconds the dragon soars away and the singer carries on singing and dancing together with an ecstatic cheering crowd in multi-camera dynamic cuts.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1] to [Shot 10]): fully_preserved — the singer's face, blue gradient hair, headband with fin ornaments, navy-and-blue maid idol dress, whale-tail ornament and silver mic are kept exactly from <Picture 1> as the target subject of every shot.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1] to [Shot 10]): fully_preserved — the truss towers, multi-beam spotlights, haze, LED walls, "deepseek" whale-logo screen with its white text and the blue light-stick crowd are copied from <Picture 2> as the constant stage geography.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 4], [Shot 6], [Shot 8], [Shot 10
): fully_preserved — the chibi whale-maid avatar's proportions, blue waved hair, white frilled headband, dark ear fins, navy dress with light-blue panels, white whale-mark apron, blue whale tail and tiny navy shoes are reproduced exactly from <Picture 3> as the animated LED-wall content.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1] to [Shot 5]): partially_preserved — only the dragon itself is transferred from <Picture 4>: its grey-black plate scales, antler horns, layered dark mane and beard, forward-coiling whiskers, glowing amber eyes, heavy clawed forelimbs and long spike-fringed tail; the human figure, rocky gorge, mountains, waterfall and sunset of <Picture 4> are removed.
<Subject 5> (appears in [Shot 1] to [Shot 5]): attribute_transfer — <Picture 5> supplies only the dragon's on-stage scale and blocking: body grounded across stage centre and stage left spanning about two thirds of the stage width, rearing neck as tall as the centre LED wall, head looming over the stage, while the singer performs small at stage right.
<Subject 6> (appears in [Shot 1] to [Shot 10]): reference — <Audio 1> drives the entire 20 seconds: the singer's lip-sync, her dance footwork, the dragon's head-bobbing and the crowd's jumping all lock to the fast tempo and vocal phrasing of <Audio 1>, and the dragon's 10-second exit falls on its beat.

detailed_description:
Live-concert music-video realism, 16:9, night-time arena; high-contrast stage lighting with cold blue beams, warm amber work lamps, volumetric haze, anamorphic flares, shallow depth of field on close-ups, crisp hold on performance wide shots; the singer (<Subject 1>) is the target subject and stays sharply lit and centred in every beat of the edit.

[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, extreme wide crane shot of the full arena: the giant dragon (<Subject 4>, sized and placed per <Subject 5>) fills stage centre and stage left, its neck rearing to the height of the centre LED wall, while <Subject 1> sings at stage right on the mic, blue-and-white dress and whale tail catching the beams. LED walls blaze with the chibi avatar (<Subject 3>) singing and dancing on both wings and with the white whale logo above the white text "deepseek" on the centre screen. Dozens of spotlights sweep the haze; blue light sticks surge in the foreground crowd. Camera cranes down toward the stage as the dragon's head swings side to side on the beat.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, medium close-up of <Subject 1>: she leans into the silver mic, eyes closing and lips forming the syllables of <Audio 1> as her blue hair whips across the frame; rapid strobe bursts flare behind her shoulder. Handheld, slight drift, hair and lace sleeves lifted by the stage fans.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, whip-pan to a low crowd shot: thousands of raised arms and blue light sticks jump in unison, haze cutting the beams into visible shafts; the singer stays silhouetted small and bright on stage right. Rapid push-in through the front row as the crowd roars.

[Shot 4] At 00:06.000, low-angle wide at the stage lip: the dragon rears and head-bobs heavily, mane and whiskers trailing, its clawed forelimb stamping the deck in time, amber eyes glowing; <Subject 1> dances alongside its shoulder, free hand punching upward on the beat. The LED avatar (<Subject 3>) mirrors the same dance step, scaled huge on the walls. Spotlights cross-hatch, lens flares raking the frame.

[Shot 5] At 00:08.000, dynamic tracking shot along the stage: the dragon coils, then launches at 00:10.000 — it sweeps upward off the deck, tail whipping through the beams, wings and mane scattering haze, and it climbs away past the truss and out of frame into the night sky, leaving the stage open and the lights cutting clean through the empty space where it stood.

[Shot 6] At 00:11.000, medium shot of <Subject 1> alone at stage centre with the mic: she follows the dragon's departure with a quick glance, then snaps back to the crowd and keeps singing and dancing to <Audio 1>, skirt and whale tail swirling, spotlights arcing across her. The LED walls keep the avatar (<Subject 3>) singing and dancing in perfect sync behind her.

[Shot 7] At 00:13.000, over-the-shoulder from behind the singer's head toward the crowd: her hair on the edge of frame, the arena boiling with jumping bodies and swinging light sticks, beams fanning out across the whole bowl. Gentle handheld sway; focus shifts from her shoulder to the far crowd and back.

[Shot 8] At 00:15.000, fast-cut multi-angle burst: a side profile of <Subject 1> throwing her head back and laughing into the lyric high point of <Audio 1>, cut with the LED avatar (<Subject 3>) belting the same line in cartoon form, cut with a top-down stage shot of her footwork stamping the deck in time.

[Shot 9] At 00:17.000, waist-up two-beat shot: the singer jumps in place, joined mid-air by the front rows of the crowd, then lands on the downbeat; sweat and glitter catch the beams, the stage deck flashing as lights rake past. Camera bobs with her jump.

[Shot 10] At 00:18.500, final hero wide, camera slowly craning up and pulling back: <Subject 1> sings and dances at the centre of the open stage, the empty space where the dragon stood now filled only with sweeping light, the LED walls and the avatar (<Subject 3>) glowing behind her and the blue light-stick crowd heaving in the foreground; she raises the mic and the frame holds on her as the track drives to the end of the 20 seconds.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous arena ambience: the crowd's roar and rhythmic chants, thousands of light sticks clicking and thrumming, deafening cheering that swells every time the singer leaps; heavy stage haze, the hollow boom of subwoofer thumps, spotlight shutters clacking and rotating, the dragon's deep chesty growl layered under the track, a grinding metal groan from the truss as the dragon's launch rattles the rigging, and the hard slap of her shoes and the dragon's claws on the deck. Sounds stay dense and live, never clean or studio-dry.

non_diegetic_music:
None beyond <Audio 1>, the fast-tempo hot song performed on stage, which is heard diegetically through the arena PA and drives the entire edit; no additional non-diegetic score is added.
